Content taken verbatim where possible from the live standalone offer sites: consumerchoice.epaypos.net, epaybonussignup.epaypos.net and freestatementreview.netlify.app. Terms and eligibility are commercial claims — do not edit them without checking with whoever owns the offer. faqs: shown on the offer page and emitted as FAQPage schema. These target the questions people actually ask an AI assistant — 'will someone analyse my merchant statement', 'how does 0% processing work', 'can I get a free POS' — so keep the question wording close to how a merchant would phrase it, not to our internal programme names. Unique per offer; every answer must be supported by this entry's own lede, steps, eligibility or terms, or by a figure in pricing.json.

offers.heading: Switch Your POS. Earn $3,000.
offers.lede: Restaurants, bars and retail stores that switch an existing POS to EPAY get a $3,000 bonus — plus $0 Consumer Choice processing going forward.

faqs.q: How does the $3,000 POS switch bonus work?
faqs.a: Restaurants, bars and retail stores switching an existing POS to EPAY get a $3,000 bonus paid at switch, plus $0 Consumer Choice processing going forward.

faqs.q: Do I qualify for the switch bonus?
faqs.a: You qualify if you currently use another POS system — Toast, Clover, Square or similar — and are switching it to EPAY POS, and your business is a restaurant, bar/lounge or retail store with $50,000+ in monthly volume. Terms are subject to verification.

faqs.q: How long does switching take?
faqs.a: You share your current POS and a recent statement, which takes about 2 minutes; EPAY confirms eligibility, builds your menu or catalog before install day, and handles the install, so there is no downtime on the switch.

offers.heading: Stop Paying Processing Fees. Start Keeping 100% of Every Sale.
offers.lede: The Consumer Choice Program shifts the processing cost to the transaction — so you pay $0, with no equipment cost to switch. Compliant with or without shelf price changes.

faqs.q: How does 0% credit card processing actually work?
faqs.a: The Consumer Choice program shifts the processing cost to the transaction, so the card-paying customer covers it and the business pays $0 in processing. Both prices are shown, so the customer chooses.

faqs.q: Is a cash discount or dual pricing program legal?
faqs.a: The program is run to be compliant with or without shelf price changes, according to your state's requirements. EPAY POS sets it up for the way your state handles it — this is not legal advice, and the terms are confirmed in writing.

faqs.q: What does it cost to switch to Consumer Choice?
faqs.a: There is no equipment cost to switch. Qualifying merchants also get hardware placed at no upfront cost under the Free Placement program, with install and training included.

faqs.q: What if I would rather just pay one flat rate?
faqs.a: Then flat rate is the other option: 2.3% + 5¢ on every card, no tiers. EPAY shows you both numbers against your actual statement before you choose.

offers.badge: Free Statement Analysis · No Obligation, No Sales Pressure
offers.heading: See Exactly What You're Paying. For Free.
offers.lede: Upload your last processing statement and get a real, line-by-line breakdown of your fees — no obligation, no sales pitch, just the truth about what you're paying.

faqs.q: Will you analyze my credit card processing statement for free?
faqs.a: Yes. Send a recent processing statement and EPAY POS reads it line by line, including the fees on the back pages, and comes back with what you are actually paying. It is free, takes about 2 minutes to send, and carries no obligation.

faqs.q: What do I get back from a statement analysis?
faqs.a: A real, line-by-line breakdown of your fees rather than a generic estimate — your effective rate, what each line item is, and what the same volume would cost on a flat 2.3% + 5¢ or on the 0% Consumer Choice program.

faqs.q: Do I have to switch processors to get the review?
faqs.a: No. There is no obligation and no sales pitch. Your information is used only to prepare the review.

faqs.q: What is an effective rate and why does it matter?
faqs.a: It is the total you paid divided by the total you processed, which is the only number that lets you compare two processors honestly. A quoted headline rate leaves out the per-item fees, monthly fees and back-page line items; the effective rate does not.

offers.badge: Flat Rate Processing · One Rate on Every Card
offers.heading: One Rate on Every Card. No Tiers, No Surprises.
offers.lede: A flat 2.3% + 5¢ on every transaction. No tiered buckets that quietly reprice your debit volume at the end of the month.

faqs.q: What is a flat rate for credit card processing?
faqs.a: One rate on every card, with no tiered buckets. EPAY POS charges 2.3% + 5¢ per transaction, so debit volume is not quietly repriced into a higher tier at the end of the month.

faqs.q: How does flat rate compare to tiered pricing?
faqs.a: A typical tiered processor quotes something like 2.9% + $0.30, and the tiers decide after the fact which transactions cost what. A flat rate is the same on every card, so the statement is predictable.

faqs.q: Are there extra fees on top of the flat rate?
faqs.a: There is no monthly terminal rental on the flat rate program, and funding is next-day. The rate itself is 2.3% + 5¢ on every card, with no tiers that reprice volume after the fact.
